description: Kartu gaya 27 template untuk prompt Muse. Teks di gambar ditulis Muse persis seperti slot. Placeholder: aspect, ink, accent, palette, headline_style, subject, headline.

T01.subject_hint: a glossy dimensional 3D object that symbolizes the topic
T01.prompt_template: Premium tech-style social poster in {aspect}. The background is solid {ink} with a soft lighter navy glow and subtle paper grain. In the lower center sits a single glossy 3D object that represents {subject}, lit with premium studio lighting and a thin {accent} rim light, with two or three small floating shapes around it. In the upper left, a huge {headline_style} in cream reads exactly "{headline}", with the last word in {accent}.

T02.subject_hint: a hand interacting with an object that represents the topic
T02.prompt_template: Bold social media poster in {aspect}, in the style of a modern digital-agency campaign. The background is a crumpled warm cream paper texture with soft creases and subtle shadows. In the center right, a high-contrast black and white cutout photograph of {subject}, with a single {accent} detail as the only color, sharp paper-cut edge and a light drop shadow. A large {ink} geometric block sits behind it at the lower left for depth. In the upper left, a huge headline in {headline_style}, deep navy, reads exactly "{headline}", with the last two words highlighted by a {accent} marker-style bar behind them.

T03.subject_hint: two or three small objects related to the topic
T03.prompt_template: Bold typography-led social poster in {aspect}. The background is solid {ink} with a subtle crumpled paper texture. In the center, a huge stacked headline in {headline_style}, cream with one key word in {accent}, reads exactly "{headline}". Around it float two or three small objects related to {subject}, tilted like stickers with thin white borders.

T04.subject_hint: a simple process or flow that explains the topic
T04.prompt_template: Social poster in {aspect}. The background is a crumpled warm cream paper texture. In the center, a large hand-drawn black marker diagram of {subject} as a simple flow with arrows and no words, next to a high-contrast black and white cutout of a hand drawing it. At the top, a headline in {headline_style} in deep navy reads exactly "{headline}".

T05.concept: Studio poster photograph, person in an armchair
T05.subject_hint: a calm student in an armchair with a related object on a side table
T05.prompt_template: Editorial studio poster photograph in {aspect} for a study-skills brand. A young student in a cream knit sweater leans back in a deep navy armchair with both hands behind the head, eyes closed with a calm, confident smile. A small round wooden side table beside the chair holds a glass of water and {subject}. The backdrop is a seamless matte navy wall ({ink}) with a soft vignette, and the floor is warm cream. Soft key light from the left, realistic fabric and paper textures, shallow depth of field. In the top third, a huge headline in {headline_style}, left aligned, white with the last two words in {accent}, reads exactly "{headline}".

T06.subject_hint: an unexpected character with a laptop on a floating rock
T06.prompt_template: Surreal tech campaign poster in {aspect}. The background is solid {ink} with soft stars of paper grain. In the lower right, a black and white cutout of an unexpected character sitting on a floating rock with a laptop, as a metaphor for {subject}, sharp paper-cut edge. In the upper left, a cream rectangular block holds a huge headline in {headline_style}, deep navy, reading exactly "{headline}".

T07.subject_hint: a laptop and phone showing a clean study-app screen
T07.prompt_template: Product-focused social poster in {aspect}. The background is solid {ink}. A huge headline in {headline_style}, cream, fills the upper half and reads exactly "{headline}". In the lower half, a laptop and a phone stand on a dark block, their screens showing a clean study-app interface about {subject} with no readable text. Two tilted {accent} ribbon strips cross the bottom corners.

T08.subject_hint: the study topic as a keyword cloud

chips.where: In the middle and lower area, tilted outlined pill-shaped capsules in cream with thick rounded borders cross each other like a playful word cloud, with bold condensed navy capitals, one of them filled {accent}

T08.prompt_template: Typography poster in {aspect}. The background is a crumpled warm cream paper texture. At the top, a huge headline in {headline_style}, deep navy, centered, reads exactly "{headline}".

T09.subject_hint: a classical marble statue figure working on a modern laptop
T09.prompt_template: Artistic campaign poster in {aspect}. The background is solid {ink} with subtle paper grain. In the center right, a black and white cutout of a classical marble statue figure working on a modern laptop, with {subject} beside it, sharp paper-cut edge. A huge headline in {headline_style}, cream, sits in the upper left and reads exactly "{headline}".

T10.subject_hint: an original friendly robot-owl mascot pointing at a floating glass tablet

chips.where: Below the headline, three short benefit rows each beginning with a small round icon

T10.prompt_template: Clean educational campaign poster in {aspect}. The background is bright cream with a soft {ink} corner. A friendly original 3D robot-owl mascot in navy and cream, with round glasses and a graduation cap, points at a floating glass tablet showing {subject}. A strong headline in {headline_style}, deep navy, sits in the upper left and reads exactly "{headline}".

chips.where: Along the left side, a vertical list of short feature rows each with a small outlined icon

T11.prompt_template: Structured social poster in {aspect}. The background is solid {ink}. On the right, a cutout photograph of a smiling young student holding books, with {subject} on a desk beside them, thin {accent} outline. A huge headline in {headline_style}, cream, sits in the upper left and reads exactly "{headline}".

T12.subject_hint: two or three rounded photo cards of the topic from different angles
T12.prompt_template: Clean evidence-style social poster in {aspect}. The background is crumpled warm cream paper. A headline in {headline_style}, deep navy, sits at the top and reads exactly "{headline}". Under it, two or three rounded photographic cards show {subject} from complementary angles, with soft shadows.

T13.subject_hint: a hand holding a melting clock as a metaphor for lost time
T13.prompt_template: Editorial problem-explainer poster in {aspect}. The background is a crumpled warm cream paper texture. At the center, a surreal photographic metaphor: {subject}, high contrast with a single {accent} accent. A huge headline in {headline_style}, deep navy, sits on the left and reads exactly "{headline}".

T14.concept: Info panel beside a relaxed person
T14.subject_hint: a relaxed person leaning back in an armchair

chips.where: On the left, a vertical list of short rows each with a small outlined icon

T14.prompt_template: Educational information poster in {aspect}. The background is solid {ink}. On the right, a cutout photograph of a relaxed person leaning back in an armchair, calm and smiling, with {subject} on a small table beside them. A huge headline in {headline_style}, cream, sits at the top and reads exactly "{headline}".

T15.subject_hint: a large polished 3D object for the topic
T15.prompt_template: Launch-style social poster in {aspect}. The background is clean cream with soft 3D lighting and a large {accent} circle behind the center. A large polished 3D object representing {subject} sits at the center. A huge headline in {headline_style}, deep navy, sits at the top and reads exactly "{headline}".

T16.subject_hint: an original mascot character presenting the idea
T16.prompt_template: Character-metaphor editorial poster in {aspect}. The background is cream with a large {ink} half-circle at the bottom. An original 3D mascot character presenting {subject} stands at the center as a clean cutout with a light shadow. A huge headline in {headline_style}, deep navy, sits at the top and reads exactly "{headline}".

T17.subject_hint: a small conceptual object that fits the topic

chips.where: In the lower half, three bold horizontal bars of different lengths in navy and {accent}, each with a short label inside the bar

T17.prompt_template: Data-style social poster in {aspect}. The background is a crumpled warm cream paper texture. A headline in {headline_style}, deep navy, sits at the top and reads exactly "{headline}". A small conceptual object representing {subject} sits at the upper right.

T18.subject_hint: a simple icon for the topic

chips.where: Below the headline, a vertical stack of equal rounded step cards numbered with small circles

T18.prompt_template: Clean checklist social poster in {aspect}. The background is light cream with a {ink} header area. A headline in {headline_style}, cream on the navy header, reads exactly "{headline}". A small illustration of {subject} sits at the right end of the header.

T19.concept: Oversized type with object in front
T19.subject_hint: a large realistic object that represents the topic
T19.prompt_template: Bold graphic-design poster in {aspect}. The background is solid {ink}. Oversized headline in {headline_style}, cream, fills much of the poster and reads exactly "{headline}". A large realistic object representing {subject} sits in front of the lower part of the letters, creating depth, while every letter stays legible.

T20.subject_hint: a person studying in a dramatic but tasteful environment
T20.prompt_template: Cinematic social poster in {aspect}. A full-frame realistic photograph of {subject}, dramatic soft lighting, graded in {palette}. A headline in {headline_style}, cream, sits in the lower third on a soft dark gradient and reads exactly "{headline}".

T21.subject_hint: floating interface cards that fit the topic
T21.prompt_template: Digital-product social poster in {aspect}. The background is light cream with a soft {ink} wave at the bottom. A huge stacked headline in {headline_style}, deep navy with one word in {accent}, sits at the top and reads exactly "{headline}". In the lower half, translucent interface cards about {subject}, without readable text.

T22.subject_hint: a large angled laptop screen showing a study interface
T22.prompt_template: Clean tech explainer poster in {aspect}. The background is cream with a soft {ink} gradient near the bottom. A large angled laptop emerges from the lower edge, its screen showing {subject} with no readable text. A headline in {headline_style}, deep navy, sits at the top and reads exactly "{headline}".

T23.subject_hint: a cluster of semi-transparent interface cards
T23.prompt_template: Polished UI-focused poster in {aspect}. The background is a {ink} to lighter navy gradient. A cluster of semi-transparent glass cards about {subject}, with soft shadows and avatars but no readable text, floats in the lower two thirds. A headline in {headline_style}, cream, sits at the top and reads exactly "{headline}".

T24.subject_hint: overlapping browser windows and creative outputs
T24.prompt_template: Creative-technology collage poster in {aspect}. The background is cream with large {ink} shapes. A layered collage of overlapping browser windows and creative outputs about {subject}, with no readable text, fills the lower section. A huge headline in {headline_style}, deep navy, sits at the top left and reads exactly "{headline}".

chips.where: Below it, a tidy grid of four small rounded cards, each card with one short label

T25.prompt_template: Structured educational poster in {aspect}. The background is light cream with thin grid lines. A headline in {headline_style}, deep navy, sits near the top and reads exactly "{headline}".

T26.subject_hint: tilted dashboard cards with abstract charts
T26.prompt_template: Dynamic digital-insight poster in {aspect}. The background is solid {ink}. Tilted floating dashboard cards about {subject}, with abstract chart shapes and no numbers or words, overlap in perspective with layered shadows across the middle and lower area. A headline in {headline_style}, cream, sits near the upper center and reads exactly "{headline}".

T27.subject_hint: a large cursor or pointer that fits the topic

chips.where: Centered below, a vertical list of short benefit rows each starting with a {accent} plus mark

T27.prompt_template: Benefit-focused social poster in {aspect}. The background is light cream with a {ink} block at the top. A headline in {headline_style}, cream on the navy block, reads exactly "{headline}". A large cutout of {subject} sits near the lower edge.
